description: unfold plugin hooks. PreToolUse on the edit tools carries the write-intent trigger to the moment it fires: the turn a session is about to write to a repository is the turn its unit's chart has to be open. SessionStart clears the once-per-epoch marker, so compaction — which drops the injected line out of context — does not leave the rest of the session without the trigger. The script stays silent outside the repositories whose charts this plugin routes to. Best-effort throughout: any internal fault exits 0 and injects nothing.
